distractors: To raise an issue to a level above your own so that somebody senior decides it.
To overstate how bad something is, so that the response it attracts is larger than the situation ever needed.
To bring about a problem that was not there before. Everything was working until this landed, and the fault traces back to it alone.
To push something beyond the rate it can safely absorb, so that the strain shows up somewhere nobody was watching. The pace is the fault rather than the direction of travel.

To trace a problem back to the decision that produced it, usually after the fact and usually in front of the people who took it. The work is in the reconstruction, and the finding is a cause rather than a cure.
